comparison.objective: Join a shelf to a cabinet side using two cam-and-bolt locks.
comparison.physical_skill: Screwdriver engagement, cam orientation, square panel insertion, bimanual panel support, and cam tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Both bolt heads enter opened cams, both cams lock, the joint closes to the specified gap, tools are returned, and hands release; excessive force on a closed cam fails.
comparison.reason: This tests keyed panel assembly and fastening. The candidate instead manipulates a loaded screen to separate media while retaining washers. Shared bimanual handling is only generic; no comparison-critical detail is missing.
